laws: Every lifecycle decision is bound to one exact subject, observation generation and latest-edit generation.
SAVED authorizes progress only when savedGeneration and latestEditGeneration equal the current generation and the reason is exact.
An active autosave is joined as one single-flight operation; a concurrent caller never receives synthetic success.
Manual save acknowledgement is exact-generation and stale completion cannot clear newer dirty state or delete its autosave.
Crash recovery consumes a branded fresh R4 reopen observation and an exact P3 physical publication classification.
External edit classification is bound to exact subject, generation and disk digest and fails closed on P3 residue or corruption.
Compound divergence suppresses save and replay recovery actions instead of selecting a weaker hazard.
BrowserWindow close and app before-quit revalidate after awaited shell persistence and immediately hand off to synchronous close/quit authority.

residualRisks: The production composition root applies the corrected barrier to BrowserWindow close and app before-quit; platform suspend is not wired in this contour.
External-edit and crash decisions require exact caller-supplied disk, R4 and P3 observations; no production external file watcher or recovery UI is attached here.
The close path uses a detached zero-effect observation because the optional R4 inbox/outbox is not attached to the production composition root.
A successful file write whose later profile or shell-state persistence fails is not promoted to a SAVED acknowledgement by this contour.
The lifecycle protocol is process-local and does not claim cross-process or cross-host conflict serialization.
No user document, storage format, dependency, SAFE_APPLY, release, signing, cloud or AI authority is added.
